CONSHOHOCKEN, Pa. - Hamilton Lane (NASDAQ:HLNE) announced today that Hartley Rogers has been named Co-Chief Executive Officer alongside Juan Delgado-Moreira, according to a press release statement.

Erik Hirsch, who previously served as Co-Chief Executive Officer, has been appointed Executive Co-Chairman. In his new role, Hirsch will focus on strategic initiatives to support the firm’s long-term growth. He will continue to represent the firm publicly, including on earnings calls, and remains a member of the Board of Directors.

Rogers has served on Hamilton Lane’s Board of Directors since 2004 and will remain Chairman of the Board while assuming the co-CEO position. He will work alongside Delgado-Moreira, who has served as Co-Chief Executive Officer since January 1, 2024.

"Hamilton Lane has been on a strong growth trajectory for years, and I look forward to working alongside Juan to continue the client-first approach that we are known for," Rogers said.

Delgado-Moreira stated that Rogers brings a deep understanding of the firm and its client relationships built globally.

Hirsch has held various positions during his tenure of more than 25 years at Hamilton Lane, including Chief Investment Officer, Vice Chairman, and most recently Co-Chief Executive Officer.

Hamilton Lane is a private markets investment firm with approximately 800 employees operating in offices across North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and the Middle East. The firm reported $1.1 trillion in assets under management and supervision as of June 30, 2026, comprising $146 billion in discretionary assets and $914 billion in non-discretionary assets.
